pair_order_definition: signed cross-bin spike-pair count at positive lags 5-60 ms, divided by product of each cell's event spike counts; A-before-B minus B-before-A
shuffle_definition: independent whole-bin permutations per event; identical-width bins partition the complete original event duration; preserve every population bin vector and each cell's total spike count
future_endpoint: change in covariate-adjusted directional RUN coordination for the same unit pair, not future single-cell rate-map agreement
inference_unit: animal; neuron pairs and repeated pauses are dependent measurements
primary_control: order-shuffled events with complete baseline and augmented pipeline re-estimation; not random sign reversal of fitted features
delivery_scope: measurement audit only; remaining endpoint/inference/calibration details must be frozen before observing the new pairwise association
historical_stopgate: Do not alter replay-order-future-20260915 protocols, outputs or negative conclusion. Its future count-map endpoint differs from this pair-coordination endpoint.
claim_boundary: Neither directional coactivity nor a predictive association proves synaptic connectivity, STDP, causation or Bayesian smoothing. Missing theta is not replaceable by spike-derived phase.
